arguments.sql_query: SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND standard_concept='S' AND concept_class_id='Ingredient' AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('atorvastatin','simvastatin','rosuvastatin','pravastatin','lovastatin','fluvastatin','pitavastatin','cerivastatin') ORDER BY concept_name;
SELECT MAX(drug_exposure_start_date) AS max_drug_date, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS min_drug_date FROM omop.drug_exposure;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients_received_statin_past_year
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1545958,1592180,1549686,1592085,40165636,1551860,1510813,1539403)
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= CAST('2025-07-22' AS date)
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST('2026-07-22' AS date));

content.text:
5,900 patients received a statin in the past year.

I counted distinct `person_id`s in `omop.drug_exposure` from 2025-07-22 through 2026-07-22, matching drug concepts descending from standard RxNorm statin ingredient concepts: atorvastatin, cerivastatin, fluvastatin, lovastatin, pitavastatin, pravastatin, rosuvastatin, and simvastatin.
